data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate proudly presents this exquisite fully furnished 1-bedroom apartment in the prestigious Address Sky View Tower 2, ideally located in the heart of Downtown Dubai. Spanning 1,051.42 sq. ft, this Sky Collection residence combines refined elegance, modern comfort, and unparalleled views of the Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Fountain.

Property Details:

Size: 1,051.42 sq. ft
Bedroom: 1 spacious en-suite with built-in wardrobes
Bathrooms: 2 elegantly designed
Living Area: Expansive open-plan layout with floor-to-ceiling windows
Kitchen: Fully fitted with premium appliances and sleek cabinetry
Balcony: Private terrace offering panoramic views of Dubai’s iconic skyline
Parking: 1 dedicated covered space
Furnishing: Fully furnished with luxurious, high-end interiors

Community & Location Highlights:

Prime address within Address Sky View, Downtown Dubai
Direct access to The Dubai Mall via an air-conditioned link bridge
Close proximity to Burj Khalifa and Dubai Opera
Exclusive infinity pool, state-of-the-art gym, spa, and fine dining outlets
24/7 concierge, valet parking, and security
Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai Metro
Managed by Address Hotels + Resorts, offering 5-star hospitality services

This exceptional residence offers the perfect blend of luxury, convenience, and investment value—ideal for discerning buyers seeking a high-ROI asset or a sophisticated home in Dubai’s most iconic destination.

For more information or to arrange a private viewing, contact Provident Real Estate today.
